title: Alcohol Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alcohol:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day alcohol metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on alcohol metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It builds what time of day your alcohol metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
